plain_english: If someone handed your body over to a stranger, you'd be furious. So why aren't you ashamed when you hand your mind over to anyone who insults you, letting them upset and confuse you?
original_excerpt: If a person had delivered up your body to some passer-by, you would certainly be angry. And do you feel no shame in delivering up your own mind to any reviler, to be disconcerted and confounded?
